covers: The registers of the YM3812 (OPL2) FM synthesizer

entries.name: test, waveform enable
entries.description: Test register. Bit 5 also enables the waveform select registers.
entries.behaviour: Bit 5 set enables the waveform select registers 0xE0 to 0xF5; with it clear every operator uses waveform 0. The other bits are test bits.

sources.cites: uint32_t waveform_enable() const                 { return IsOpl2 ? byte(0x01, 5, 1) : (IsOpl3Plus ? 1 : 0); }

entries.name: timer 1 value
entries.description: Timer 1 preset: the 8-bit value timer 1 loads when it starts.
entries.behaviour: Holds timer 1's 8-bit preset, which MAME scales by 4. Starting and masking it are bits of the timer control register.

sources.cites: 02h	Timer #1 data (OPL2 and OPL3 in OPL2 mode only)

entries.name: timer 2 value
entries.description: Timer 2 preset: the 8-bit value timer 2 loads when it starts.
entries.behaviour: Holds timer 2's 8-bit preset. Starting and masking it are bits of the timer control register.

sources.cites: 03h	Timer #2 data (OPL2 and OPL3 in OPL2 mode only)

entries.name: timer control
entries.description: Timer control: starts, stops and masks the two timers and resets their flags.
entries.behaviour: Bit 7 resets the timer flags and the interrupt, bit 6 masks timer 1, bit 5 masks timer 2, bit 1 starts timer 2 and bit 0 starts timer 1.

sources.cites: 04h	Timer control flags (OPL2 and OPL3 in OPL2 mode only)

entries.name: CSM, note select
entries.description: Mode register: the keyboard split point and the CSM mode.
entries.behaviour: Bit 7 selects speech synthesis (CSM) mode instead of FM music and bit 6 the keyboard split (note select) point.

entries.name: rhythm and depth
entries.description: Rhythm register: the tremolo and vibrato depths, the rhythm mode and its five key-on bits.
entries.behaviour: Bit 7 selects the deep tremolo, bit 6 the deep vibrato, bit 5 enables rhythm mode, and bits 4 to 0 key on the bass drum, snare, tom, top cymbal and high hat.

sources.cites: BDh	percussion, vibrato, AM	(OPL2, OPL3 in OPL2 mode only)

entries.name: operator mode
entries.description: Operator mode: tremolo, vibrato, envelope type, key scaling and the frequency multiplier, one register per operator.
entries.behaviour: Bit 7 enables tremolo, bit 6 vibrato, bit 5 the sustained envelope, bit 4 key scale rate, bits 3 to 0 the frequency multiple. Each address in the range is one operator's register: operators sit at offsets 0 to 5, 8 to 13 and 16 to 21 from the first address.

entries.name: operator level
entries.description: Operator level: key scale level and total level, one register per operator.
entries.behaviour: Bits 7 and 6 give the key scale level and bits 5 to 0 the total level. Each address in the range is one operator's register: operators sit at offsets 0 to 5, 8 to 13 and 16 to 21 from the first address.

entries.name: attack, decay
entries.description: Operator envelope: attack rate and decay rate, one register per operator.
entries.behaviour: Bits 7 to 4 give the attack rate and bits 3 to 0 the decay rate. Each address in the range is one operator's register: operators sit at offsets 0 to 5, 8 to 13 and 16 to 21 from the first address.

entries.name: sustain, release
entries.description: Operator envelope: sustain level and release rate, one register per operator.
entries.behaviour: Bits 7 to 4 give the sustain level and bits 3 to 0 the release rate. Each address in the range is one operator's register: operators sit at offsets 0 to 5, 8 to 13 and 16 to 21 from the first address.

entries.name: F-number low
entries.description: Frequency number, low byte: one register per channel.
entries.behaviour: Holds the low 8 bits of the channel's frequency number; bits 1 and 0 of the matching 0xB0 register are the high bits. Each address in the range is one channel's register.

entries.name: key on, block
entries.description: Key on, octave and the frequency number's high bits: one register per channel.
entries.behaviour: Bit 5 keys the channel on, bits 4 to 2 give the block (octave) and bits 1 and 0 the high bits of the frequency number. Each address in the range is one channel's register.

entries.name: feedback, connection
entries.description: Channel feedback and connection: one register per channel.
entries.behaviour: Bits 3 to 1 give the feedback of the first operator and bit 0 selects the connection (algorithm). Each address in the range is one channel's register.

sources.cites: uint32_t ch_feedback(uint32_t choffs) const      { return byte(0xc0, 1, 3, choffs); }

entries.name: operator waveform
entries.description: Operator waveform select, one register per operator.
entries.behaviour: Bits 1 and 0 select one of four waveforms, used only when bit 5 of register 0x01 enables them. Each address in the range is one operator's register: operators sit at offsets 0 to 5, 8 to 13 and 16 to 21 from the first address.

sources.cites: uint32_t op_waveform(uint32_t opoffs) const      { return waveform_enable() ? byte(0xe0, 0, newflag() ? 3 : 2, opoffs) : 0; }
